prompt:
Use case: style-transfer and identity-preserve.
Create a final reusable later-stage full-body named character source C01-CHAR-CAIN-02 as a native 1024x1536 RGBA transparent PNG. Reference1 is the APPROVED named stage01 portrait and PRIMARY authority for FACE, skin/ethnicity, BIG HEAD/HANDS, broad readable proportions, strong dark contours and chunky MATTE rendering. Reference2 is an old later-stage card: use only its named stage POSE and specified EQUIPMENT, NOT its background/frame, gritty fine texture or any conflicting face/age.
Match reference1's bold small-game-portrait art EXACTLY: much BIGGER head and hands, stocky broad torso, short sturdy limbs, about FOUR head-lengths total from helmet/head top to boot soles. Maintain adult anatomy despite cartoon proportions. Heavy dark outer outline, broad flat midtone color masses with a few matte painted facets. Faces and equipment bright/readable, not dark/blackened. Simplify all tiny texture, hair strands, thin etched rivets, scratch noise, filigree. Wear must be few broad patches/scuffs, no gritty granular surface. Full silhouette and complete feet/props comfortably INSIDE all edges.
Subject and role: Cain, later independent imperial reform-army commander, recognizably the SAME named adult officer as reference1. Keep the severe rectangular clean-shaven face, strong straight nose, black brows, steady dark eyes, warm skin, and open-faced navy/steel helmet with broad old-gold bands. Resolute and thoughtful, not villainous. Use navy/cream imperial tunic and tabard, same broad imperial gold-edged armor shapes as reference1 with modest scuffs, a muted burgundy scarf/cape lining, sturdy armored boots and brown belt. Later standing pose from reference2: his right hand at viewer-left grips a sword angled down across the front toward viewer-right, and his left arm at viewer-right bears a ROUND shield. Shield is navy and pale gold with a simple cream/gold four-armed star/cross taken directly from reference2; NO new heraldry. Retain his imperial flag rather than Gray Flag identity: a small folded navy imperial standard is secured behind his viewer-left shoulder, only a short hanging fabric panel visible, bearing the SAME gold diamond/cross motif visible on reference1's tall shield. No new emblem, no crown, no gray/red alliance insignia. He stays an independent imperial ally, never dressed in Gray Flag uniform. The source sword/round-shield is portrait equipment only; do not imply a new combat unit or change spear combat.
Composition: single full-body figure, slightly three-quarter, centered at generous near-full canvas scale with large head near the upper margin and wide readable hands. Leave at least35px genuinely transparent margin around ALL body and props; no cropping. Complete soles near bottom with margin, no floor. Native output MUST be 1024x1536.
Transparency constraints: isolated character and carried equipment only on genuine transparent alpha. NO parchment/card/frame, NO text, no checkerboard, no environment, no cast/contact/drop shadow, no glow or halo. Every canvas edge actually transparent. Do not include black/white background, do not imitate transparency. Preserve full canvas.
